{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for missing customer_age
missing_age = data['customer_age'] == -1
print(f"Number of missing age entries (customer_age == -1): {missing_age.sum()}")

# Show the distribution of channels and segments
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(data['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Confirm the total row count
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")"}
